title: ophrys oxyrrhynchos subsp. celiensis
intro: Ophrys oxyrrhynchos subsp. celiensis, commonly known as the "Snake's Head Orchid", is a plant species that belongs to the genus Ophrys, characterized by its unique, snake-like appearance. The health benefits of this plant include its potential use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys oxyrrhynchos subsp. celiensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
